sources.title: IBM i 7.4 — Displaying and printing journal entries

requiredText: Opt  Date      Time      Type  User        Job        Message
notes: Interactive DSPJRN shows journal metadata then entry subfile. Security audit journal QAUDJRN uses entry types PW, AF, CP, etc. Layout-audit sample filters PW AF CP.
asciiPanel:
DSPJRN                           Display Journal Entries                 CLAIMS400

      Journal  . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : QAUDJRN
      Library  . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : QSYS
      Entry type . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : PW AF CP
      Type options, press Enter.

F1=Help   F3=Exit   F5=Refresh   F7=Page up   F8=Page down   F11=Job IP   F12=Cancel
auditNotes: QAUDJRN is append-only; receiver rotation via CHGJRN/CRTJRNRCV. Save receivers before DLTRCV. ENTTYP codes: PW password, AF authority failure, CP change profile, CD create/delete object.

entryTypes.CD: Create or delete object (when QAUDLVL includes *CREATE/*DELETE)
